title: 第10章 贵客上门
novel_title: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
张芷看到郁景走了过来，一脸志在必得的表情。

    “张姐，我家里人在等我，我就不跟您一起吃饭了，单已经对完了，我要回家了。”

    张芷听到郁景这样说，脸上的笑容都僵硬了下来。

    “小郁，你确定？”她似笑非笑的说，可眼中的情绪显然是在威胁。“这段时间可是业绩考核期，你的业绩可是不太好看呢。”

    郁景得到了自己的爷爷和父亲的支持，他才不怕这点威胁。

    大不了就是不干了！

    “张姐，饭我就不吃了，业绩的事情您看着办吧，我明天就会请辞。”

    张芷得到这样的答案很显然不在她的意料中。

    “你居然想辞职？！”她很清楚郁景的家庭条件，自从他的父亲出事后，工作的更加卖力了，要不是自己压着，他可能早就升职了。

    如果他说说好话，自己也不会一直想着要压制他。

    “郁景，你好好想想你家里的状况，辞职这话我就当没听到。”张芷想着自己或许应该再给郁景一个机会。

    “这样吧，你陪我吃了今天这顿饭，我就给总经理说说你升职的事情。”

    想让我用自己换一个升职的机会？

    郁景不是没有听说过张姐的一些私人作风的事情，听人家说张姐手段可不干净。

    “不用了，升职的机会您还是留给其他人吧，我嘴不甜，也不想出卖自己的身体去换取这点利润。”郁景将手中的工牌取了下来，丢在桌子上，直接开始收拾自己的东西。

    张芷被气笑了：“好，郁景，你好样的，你不想做，多的是人想做。”

    “要不是看你长得还可以，你以为你还能留在这个公司。”

    郁景可不管这些，他拿起收好的东西便不再管气急败坏的张芷，直接走出了公司大门。

    直到走到公交站，他才深深的舒了一口气，自己总算是摆脱这该死的工作了。

    郁景回家后，原本以为大家都在休息了，没想到一家人都聚在客厅在看电视。

    郁凌和郁颜正在跟他们爷爷科普着现代社会的一些常识，努力的想让自家爷爷融入现代社会。
content_en:
Zhang Zhi saw Yu Jing coming over with a determined expression on his face.

"Sister Zhang, my family is waiting for me, so I won't have dinner with you. I've finished paying the bills and I'm going home."

When Zhang Zhi heard what Yu Jing said, the smile on his face froze.

"Xiaoyu, are you sure?" She said with a half-smile, but the emotion in her eyes was obviously threatening."This period is the performance appraisal period, and your performance is not very good."

Yu Jing has the support of his grandfather and father, so he is not afraid of this threat.

The worst thing is to quit!

"Sister Zhang, I won't eat anymore. You can take care of the performance matters. I will resign tomorrow."

Zhang Zhi's answer was obviously not what she expected.

"You actually want to resign?!" She knew very well about Yu Jing's family conditions. Since his father's accident, he had worked even harder. If she hadn't pressured him, he might have been promoted long ago.

If he said nice things, I wouldn't keep thinking about suppressing him.

"Yu Jing, think carefully about the situation at home. I'll pretend you didn't hear about your resignation." Zhang Zhi thought that maybe she should give Yu Jing another chance.

"Let's do this. You have this meal with me today, and I'll tell the general manager about your promotion."

Do you want me to trade myself for a promotion opportunity?

It's not like Yu Jing hasn't heard about Sister Zhang's personal style. People say that Sister Zhang's methods are not clean.

"No, you should leave the opportunity for promotion to others. I don't want to be sweet, and I don't want to sell my body in exchange for this profit." Yu Jing took off the work badge in his hand, threw it on the table, and started to pack his things.

Zhang Zhi laughed angrily: "Okay, Yu Jing, good on you. If you don't want to do it, there are many people who want to do it."

"If it weren't for your good looks, you think you could still stay in this company."

Yu Jing didn't care about this. He picked up the things he had put away and ignored the frustrated Zhang Zhi, and walked directly out of the company door.

It wasn't until he reached the bus stop that he breathed a deep sigh of relief, finally getting rid of this damn job.

After Yu Jing returned home, he originally thought everyone was resting, but unexpectedly the whole family gathered in the living room and watched TV.

Yu Ling and Yu Yan are trying to popularize some common sense about modern society with their grandfather, trying hard to integrate their grandfather into modern society.
title_en: Chapter 10 Distinguished Guests Come to the Door
